points: Architected an end-to-end Voice AI RAG agent with real-time WebSocket audio streaming, streaming speech-to-text (Deepgram), agentic tool calling (DeepSeek), and Edge-TTS synthesis for automated product discovery and order tracking.

Built a GenAI image generation agent and microservice using FastAPI and Google Gemini API, integrated into a Laravel + Amazon S3 ERP system for automated product visualization and multi-part image processing.
Extended a Laravel and Node.js/Angular.js e-commerce platform with shipment dispatching, stock verification, and CRM webhook integrations, improving the lead generation pipeline.
Implemented JWT-based user authentication and Role-Based Authorization (RBAC) across multiple REST API services, strengthening application security.
Optimized Angular and Node.js application load times by up to 70% through front-end performance tuning and elimination of code duplication.
Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Laravel for an e-commerce shipping platform, implementing Eloquent ORM relationships, custom middleware, and Form Request validation.
Applied Service Layer Architecture to separate business logic from controllers, improving code maintainability and scalability.
Used Laravel Queues and Jobs for asynchronous shipment processing, increasing system throughput and reliability.

bio: Full-Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience in WordPress, Laravel, React JS, Node.js, Express.js, and Angular. Experienced in building and maintaining RESTful APIs, implementing JWT-based authentication, Service Layer Architecture, and Async Queue processing.

I've built Voice AI RAG agents and GenAI image generation microservices using FastAPI, Google Gemini API, and Deepgram, and enjoy working across the entire stack — from designing a database schema in the morning to tuning frontend performance in the afternoon.
When I'm not writing code, I'm probably thinking about the next side project, exploring Linux configurations, or researching something niche on the internet.
